description: Answers the domain-binding challenge: makes one outbound, Server-Side Request Forgery (SSRF)-guarded, per-host rate-limited HTTPS GET to the well-known path this draft's status already names (domainChallengeWellKnownPath) on the declared URL's host, and checks it serves back the exact domainChallengeToken. Serve that token at that path on your domain BEFORE calling this. Repeat calls re-run the same probe and simply re-record its current result. Requires the access code.

accessCode.description: The one-time access code returned by self_register_agent_card for this draft.
